label: Uneasy calm
summary: Diplomacy and violence ran side by side. Iran said Washington was "not serious" about talks, and a vessel caught fire off Iraq's coast, but envoys from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan kept talking in Tehran. Jordan struck Syria after a church attack, killing at least seven people. In Ukraine, Russia paused strikes on Kherson province so aid could reach occupied Oleshky. In Brazil, Bolsonaro's party accepted Lula's victory despite Trump calling the vote rigged, though the real fell. African trade officials warned that the Iran war threatens food security, and people are missing after a drilling platform sank off Gabon. A scrub fire forced evacuations in Central Otago. Science offered some lift: OpenAI reported AI-driven research results, and an endangered river dolphin population grew. The weighted formula gave 43; no editorial adjustment.
